best_hook.why: Maid declares in front of the nobles that someone has been poisoning the Duchess; shocking accusation that is instantly twisted against her.

best_cliffhanger.why: Framed heroine is seized and dragged off by the guard; her fate is unresolved.

must_promos.why: Self-contained frame-up: she exposes the poisoning, Catherine twists it into a confession, the nobleman condemns her and orders 'Take her', cut as she is dragged away.
Lost-son ring reveal, the Duchess asks the husband's name, pounding interrupts, villains burst in and Catherine demands 'Show me your hand' with the ring about to be exposed.

standalone_risk: Strangers may not realise the accusers (Rupert and Catherine) are the actual poisoners, so the irony of the frame is partly lost; the ring's significance needs the lost-son line to land.
